**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use covenant on Tri City. Targeted searches ("compete/competing", "shall not develop/market/sell", territory, exclusivity) surfaced nothing restricting the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build.

The three candidate provisions are all something else:
- **§ 21.7(B) (p0273)** — internal-business-purpose and no-resale limit on the Services: a conventional licence-scope/resale restriction, not a restraint on our business or on what we may develop or acquire.
- **§ 23.5 (p0313)** — source-code use confined to internal processing and then-existing functionalities: standard escrow-licence scope.
- **§ 10.3(A) (p0183)** — obligation to source Monthly Base Fee Services from M&I during the Term: a sourcing/minimum-commitment term properly reviewed under EXCLUSIVITY/MINCOMMIT, and not double-flagged here.

No redline proposed.
